key_reasoning.reason: The diffstat reports 40 files changed (+9348/-472), which maps to XXL. Most of them are content: the codemie-html-report skill was replaced wholesale (references, CSS bundle, fonts, a vendored Chart.js, deck JS, build and inject scripts, with the old CommonJS inject-*.js removed) and the new codemie-humanizer skill was added. Only the manifest bump and one new test touch code that the project runs.

The change spans three plugin skills (codemie-html-report updated, codemie-humanizer new, a codemie-analytics handoff edit), the Claude plugin manifest and one drift-guard test, all inside src/agents/plugins/claude/. That is several components but a single subsystem.

The request was to copy two skills, update one and bump the plugin version, with 'fully validate it'. It left open how far to adapt the copies, and the follow-up commits show that adaptation happened: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT path resolution, the ESM-only scripts, dropped licence headers and the analytics handoff.

An exact pattern exists: copy and adapt from a sibling skill repo, with rollback by revert. The scripts spawn node and headless Chrome locally but are not part of the CLI runtime. The new skills-shared-files.test.ts checks that slop-scan.mjs and glossary.md stay byte-identical between the two skills, and that the scripts are ESM and never call require().
No package manifests changed. Chart.js (chart.umd.min.js) and OFL-licensed fonts are vendored as static skill assets, so the score is S rather than XS.
